item.title: REF 0.10.1
item.description:
• A new look: clean Cold Steel by default (Gritty in Settings), plus the suite's skins (Fracture, Minimal Poster, Pixel / Game and more) in Settings.
  • One Songs panel: each song's overview and zoomed lanes sit together, and any lane takes a dropped file.
  • RGB waveforms like rekordbox and Traktor, and zoom past a bar down to 96 samples.
  • The reference library: songs, labels, kept measurements and bookmarks, plus Archive References and Open Archive.
  • Reference slots: up to 16 references, as a setting.
  • Match EQ: a surgical EQ curve and printout in the Tone tab. Hear it, and keep it in the mix.
  • Tonal balance against a target range, with the exact values under the pointer. A set's range is its middle 80 % of songs (a setting).
  • Band solo (with Spot) and Left/Right listening, pan by band, named PSR targets and note names under the pointer.
  • Over-time charts with a shaded reference, lined up at the drops.
  • Lock a cue point at each song's drop.
  • PAIN beside each song's LUFS.
  • Meter panels you can switch on and off, resize and drag to reorder.
  • A quieter top area: Settings > Advanced brings the rest back. Notes are one line each, with Don't show this again.
  • A glossary: hover cards on terms and a Glossary window.
  • The REF plug-in: a live tone curve and your master's waveform while the DAW plays, the reference can follow your DAW, and its windows float with the plug-in window.
  • Lighter: less memory and less CPU while nothing plays.
